name: ClaimPrism
author: parsec66

sections.description:
ClaimPrism is a local-first risk-screening tool for WordPress and WooCommerce.

Version 0.6 scans product titles, short descriptions, descriptions, common SEO metadata, featured-image alt text, WooCommerce gallery alt text, WordPress pages and posts for deterministic risk signals associated with environmental marketing claims. Large stores are processed in resumable background batches. Evidence can be linked to a specific detected claim, with dashboard alerts for expired and soon-to-expire documentation. A Review Priority indicator and next-action queue help triage the findings, and the current review can be exported to CSV.

ClaimPrism does not determine legal compliance and does not provide legal advice. Automated findings can include false positives and always require human review.

Privacy

Version 0.6 performs scanning locally in WordPress and does not send scanned content to an external ClaimPrism service. The live editor check uses only the site’s own authenticated WordPress REST API.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the claimprism folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install its ZIP package.
  2. Activate ClaimPrism.
  3. In WooCommerce, open WooCommerce > ClaimPrism. Without WooCommerce, use Tools > ClaimPrism.
  4. Select “Scan store now”.
sections.faq:
Does ClaimPrism guarantee compliance?

No. It is an automated screening assistant. The legal assessment depends on the claim, evidence, presentation, jurisdiction and specific circumstances.

Does the MVP use AI or send my catalog to a cloud service?

No. Version 0.6 uses local deterministic rules for both saved-content and live-editor checks.

Which content is scanned?

Published, draft and private WooCommerce products, WordPress pages and posts. ClaimPrism also checks common Yoast/Rank Math/AIOSEO title and description metadata, featured-image alt text and WooCommerce gallery alt text. Individual items are re-scanned when saved, and a weekly scheduled full scan runs in resumable batches.

What does the evidence registry do?

It stores references such as a certificate name, issuer, URL, expiry date and notes as WordPress post metadata. Evidence may be linked to a specific detected claim. ClaimPrism highlights expired and soon-to-expire entries, but never interprets an evidence entry as an automatic compliance approval.
sections.changelog:
0.6.0

  • Rebrand the plugin as ClaimPrism before its first public WordPress.org submission.
  • Align the public plugin slug, text domain, REST namespace, extension hooks and development tooling with the ClaimPrism name.

0.5.0

  • Add a 0–100 Review Priority workload indicator with explicit non-compliance-score wording.
  • Add a prioritized next-action queue and affected-content count.
  • Add a local UTF-8 CSV review export with spreadsheet-formula injection protection.

0.4.1

  • Add reproducible WordPress Playground development environment with PHP 8.3 and WooCommerce 11.0.0.
  • Add automated Playground integration regression test for WooCommerce and Italian environmental claims.
  • Detect the common straight-apostrophe form of “sostenibile per l’ambiente”.

0.4.0

  • Stable claim keys for claim-to-evidence linking.
  • Evidence entries can be linked to a specific saved finding.
  • Dashboard distinguishes linked, unlinked and expired evidence.
  • Dashboard alerts for evidence expired or expiring within 30 days.
  • Public filters/actions added as a clean extension boundary for future add-ons.
  • Extension API documentation included.

0.3.0

  • Resumable full-store scanning in batches to reduce request timeout risk.
  • Background progress state and dashboard progress indicator.
  • Common Yoast, Rank Math and AIOSEO title/description metadata screening.
  • Featured-image alt-text screening.
  • WooCommerce product-gallery alt-text screening.
  • Background scan test coverage.

0.2.0

  • Live environmental-claim risk screening in the WordPress/WooCommerce editor.
  • Authenticated local REST endpoint for on-demand content checks.
  • Per-content evidence and certification registry with expiry tracking.
  • Evidence status shown alongside dashboard findings.
  • Live check request-size guard and editor failure fallback.

0.1.0

  • Initial MVP.
  • Local deterministic claim scanner.
  • WooCommerce/WordPress admin dashboard.
  • Automatic scan on save and weekly scheduled scan.
  • English, Italian, German, French, Spanish and Dutch risk-signal vocabulary.
